releaseNotes:
Version 5.5 fixes a data loss bug caused by using the cache folder instead of the files folder. The corrective migration activity will automatically move your data to the right folder. This version now uses Mednafen 1.29.0 and targets Android 14.

As a reminder, this app is available for free on the Google Play Store, where you can get the latest updates automatically. I do not recommend downloading WonderDroid X from here unless your phone is not Google Play certified or you live in a country where we do not offer this app on the Play Store (e.g. France).
author: williehwc
